# @verevoir/qrcode

> Thin compatibility shim around `@verevoir/qr` that exposes the same method names as the `qrcode` npm package — one runtime dependency, runs standalone in Node, browsers, and edge runtimes.

## Install

```bash
npm install @verevoir/qrcode
```

For PNG output, also install the optional peer dependency:

```bash
npm install @verevoir/qrcode @resvg/resvg-js
```

## Core Exports

### Isomorphic entry (default)

Re-exports everything from `@verevoir/qr/qrcode`. Covers `create`, `toString`, and `toDataURL` — works in Node, browsers, Cloudflare Workers, Deno, and Bun.

```typescript
import QRCode from '@verevoir/qrcode';

// SVG string
const svg = await QRCode.toString('https://verevoir.io', { type: 'svg' });

// With a visual style (square | dots | diamonds | horizontal | vertical |
// diagonal | network | circuit | metro | scribble | photo | logo | color-logo)
const styled = await QRCode.toString('https://verevoir.io', {
  type: 'svg',
  style: 'dots',
});

// Data URL (SVG or PNG — PNG requires @resvg/resvg-js)
const dataUrl = await QRCode.toDataURL('https://verevoir.io');

// Low-level matrix
const qr = QRCode.create('https://verevoir.io');
```

### Node entry (`@verevoir/qrcode/node`)

Re-exports everything from `@verevoir/qr/qrcode/node`. Adds `toFile` and `toBuffer` on top of the isomorphic surface.

```typescript
import QRCode from '@verevoir/qrcode/node';

// Write SVG to disk
await QRCode.toFile('code.svg', 'https://verevoir.io', { type: 'svg' });

// Write PNG to disk (requires @resvg/resvg-js)
await QRCode.toFile('code.png', 'https://verevoir.io', { type: 'png' });

// PNG as a Buffer (requires @resvg/resvg-js)
const buf = await QRCode.toBuffer('https://verevoir.io');
```

### Web entry (`@verevoir/qrcode/web`)

Re-exports everything from `@verevoir/qr/qrcode/web`. Adds `toCanvas` for browser use.

```typescript
import QRCode from '@verevoir/qrcode/web';

const canvas = document.getElementById('qr') as HTMLCanvasElement;
await QRCode.toCanvas(canvas, 'https://verevoir.io');
```

## Notes

- **This package is a re-export shim.** All logic lives in [`@verevoir/qr`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@verevoir/qr). If you need multi-candidate mask ranking, fine-grained colour control, or fabrication-ready layer separation, use that package directly.
- **Thirteen visual styles** are available via the `style` option: `square`, `dots`, `diamonds`, `horizontal`, `vertical`, `diagonal`, `network`, `circuit`, `metro`, `scribble`, `photo`, `logo`, `color-logo`. The `photo`, `logo`, and `color-logo` styles require a `PhotoSampler` and are not reachable through this shim — use `@verevoir/qr` directly for those.
- **`version` and `maskPattern` options are accepted but ignored.** The engine selects the optimal version and mask automatically.
- **`color.dark` / `color.light` are reliable on `square` only.** Other styles use SVG path construction where colour substitution is less predictable.
- **Callback forms are supported.** Every method accepts an `(err, result)` callback as its last argument in addition to returning a Promise.

## Limitations

- PNG output requires the optional peer dependency `@resvg/resvg-js`. Without it, PNG calls throw `Module not found` at runtime.
- `toFile` and `toBuffer` are Node-only (the `/node` entry point). They are not present on the isomorphic or web entries.
- `toCanvas` is browser-only (the `/web` entry point).
